documentation.name: AnimationPipeline.md
documentation.summary: Explains the request-driven animation architecture, registry-based asset lookup, native AnimGraph layering, montage playback, and the replication bridge between authoritative locomotion state and client presentation.

documentation.name: HudWidgets.md
documentation.summary: Describes the modular C++ HUD composition model, including local-player ownership, reusable widget components, and the life-bar implementation pattern.

documentation.name: InputPipeline.md
documentation.summary: Documents how Enhanced Input callbacks become replicated control intent, how authoritative gameplay systems consume that intent, and how locomotion state feeds movement and animation presentation.

documentation.name: Profiles.md
documentation.summary: Provides the setup workflow for keyed visual, animation, combat-attachment, and control-mapping profiles, including native skeletal-mesh animation slots and skeleton-specific bone mappings.

config.name: DefaultEditor.ini
config.summary: Defines shared Unreal Editor asset-preview scene profiles and editor-only visualization defaults.

config.name: DefaultEngine.ini
config.summary: Configures maps, game mode, desktop rendering, Lumen, ray tracing, Substrate, shader models, audio, and platform RHIs.

config.name: DefaultGame.ini
config.summary: Defines project identity plus profile-driven character visuals, animations, controls, and playable-actor defaults.

config.name: DefaultInput.ini
config.summary: Configures legacy axis properties, Enhanced Input classes, mouse capture, motion controls, and console input.

list.name: Runtime Actors
list.description: Character classes and game-mode composition roots that own Unreal object lifetimes, assemble components, and connect player or NPC instances to the gameplay framework.

list.name: Gameplay Components
list.description: Replicated and local actor state for control, stats, combat, perception, animation registries, movesets, and collision volumes consumed by higher-level systems.

list.name: Gameplay Systems
list.description: World-scoped orchestration for movement, stamina, AI, perception, combat phases, hit detection, camera behavior, and animation requests, including the explicit gameplay scheduler.

list.name: Contracts and Messaging
list.description: Shared enums, payload structures, combat and animation data types, and the typed world event bus that decouple producers from gameplay-system consumers.

list.name: Presentation
list.description: Local-player HUD controllers and modular UMG widget components that translate replicated gameplay state into client-side interface output.

list.name: Project and Platform
list.description: Unreal module entry points, target and build rules, project descriptor, engine/game/input configuration, asset settings, and other platform-facing integration.

list.name: Documentation
list.description: Maintainer guides for input, animation, character profiles, and HUD extension workflows.
